_comment: Shadow Hand (MuJoCo Menagerie) joint angles in radians for each preshape of GraspCatalog.cs.
open: the preshape, i.e. the hand while approaching; closed: the target the position actuators drive the
fingers towards when closing (contacts with the object stop them earlier). Missing joints are 0.
Joints: WRJ2 WRJ1 (wrist), FFJ4..1 MFJ4..1 RFJ4..1 (J4 abduction, J3 MCP flexion, J2 J1 coupled by a tendon),
LFJ5..1 (J5 metacarpal cupping), THJ5..1 (J5 base rotation, J4 abduction in front of the palm).
grasp_point: the point of the hand put at the center of the grasp parallelepiped: palm (grasp_site of
right_hand.xml, 3.5 cm in front of the finger bases) or a list of fingers, e.g. [TH, FF, MF]: the midpoint
between the thumb tip and the mean of the other fingertips (the thumb tip alone for [TH]), in the closed configuration.
First approximation, tune them with the viewer (python_scripts/MuJoCo/preshape_viewer.py).

power_no3.description: Power grasp: all fingers and opposed thumb, open around the object

pinch_no3.description: Pinch with the four fingers (prismatic_4fingers): straight fingers against the opposed thumb

pinch_3.description: Tripod (tripod, prismatic_2fingers): thumb, index and middle; ring and little curled away

lateral_no3.description: Lateral grasp (adducted_thumb): fingers curled, the thumb closes on the side of the index
